name_zh: 柬埔寨·阇耶跋摩七世：吴哥佛教与医院水利基建
name_en: Cambodia Jayavarman VII: Angkor Buddhism & Hospital Water Infrastructure
description_zh: 阇耶跋摩七世 (1122-1218) 吴哥大帝，大乘佛教悲心建立102座医院、121座驿站、西/东巴雷水利系统，湾仔寺微笑面相成佛教艺术巅峰，构建前工业时代福利国家雏形。
description_en: Jayavarman VII (1122-1218) Angkor Great King, Mahayana Buddhist compassion built 102 hospitals, 121 rest houses, West/East Baray water systems, Bayon Temple smiling faces Buddhist art peak, constructed pre-industrial welfare state prototype.
reason_zh: 阇耶跋摩七世代表古代君主如何将宗教悲心转化为公共福利制度，展示了水利基建与医疗网络如何支撑帝国人口繁荣，其湾仔寺微笑成为柬埔寨永恒精神象征。
reason_en: Jayavarman VII represents ancient monarch transforming religious compassion into public welfare system, demonstrating how water infrastructure and medical network sustain imperial population prosperity, his Bayon smiling faces becoming Cambodia eternal spiritual symbol.
steps_zh: 研究阇耶跋摩七世早年流亡占婆与佛教皈依
分析1181年即位后大乘佛教悲心政策全面推行
探讨102医院121驿站福利网络与水利巴雷系统
评估湾仔寺微笑面相佛教艺术巅峰与帝国粘合
总结吴哥佛教医院水利基建对前工业福利国家的历史超越
steps_en: Study Jayavarman VII early Champa exile and Buddhist conversion
Analyze 1181 accession Mahayana Buddhist compassion policy comprehensive implementation
Explore 102 hospitals 121 rest houses welfare network and Baray water systems
Evaluate Bayon Temple smiling faces Buddhist art peak and imperial glue
Summarize Angkor Buddhism hospital water infrastructure historical transcendence for pre-industrial welfare state
expected_zh: 掌握宗教悲心转化公共福利的制度化路径，理解水利医疗双轮驱动帝国繁荣逻辑，评估阇耶跋摩七世对现代柬埔寨公共卫生与水利传统的千年遗产。
expected_en: Master religious compassion institutionalization into public welfare path, understand water-medical dual wheel driving imperial prosperity logic, evaluate Jayavarman VII millennium legacy for modern Cambodian public health and water tradition.
case_zh: 1122 出生；1181 即位；1218 逝世。吴哥佛教医院水利基建范式永存。
case_en: 1122 birth; 1181 accession; 1218 death. Angkor Buddhism hospital water infrastructure paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Khmer Buddhist Monarchy / Welfare State / Hydraulic Civilization
cross_cultural_impact: Ancient welfare state; hospital system; hydraulic engineering; Buddhist kingship
artistic_legacy: 是: 湾仔寺/吴哥建筑
